episode.tagline: Everyone wants to read more — but how do we do it? As lifelong readers, our hosts get asked this all the time, and decided to do an exhaustive primer with three parts.
episode.about: In this episode, Amit does his best to answer the three questions above — but please don’t stop watching this show if you do end up reading more!
